fusions.name: Pounce to Pinch
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and pinch, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicked Biter
fusions.desc: Flicks a flea off your fingertip that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hop dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Scratch the Itch
fusions.desc: You rake your nails over your skin and remove 2 conditions from yourself. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Twitchy Fingers
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 12% critical hit chance for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
